# Our Menu

## Things Are Just Better When They’re Fresh

Freshly churned ice cream mixed with your choice of candy, fruit, nuts or cake on a frozen granite stone. Choose from Signature ice cream Creations™, ice cream cakes, cupcakes, pies, milkshakes and smoothies. Order online for pickup or delivery, or find a Cold Stone® location near you.

 [Limited-Time Favorites](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/limited-time-offers/) [Ice Cream](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/ice-cream/) [Cakes & Pies](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/cakes/) [Silk & Sorbet](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/dairy-free-ice-cream-sorbet/) [Milkshakes & Smoothies](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/milkshakes-fruit-smoothies/) [Novelties](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/novelties/)

If you have allergies, or require special considerations before visiting, please consult our [Ice Cream FAQs](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/ice-cream/) for more information. You’ll find details on our gluten-free products, lactose-free and low-fat options, as well as nut and egg allergy concerns and kosher certification.
